info.name: Amazon CloudFormation Change Sets Stacks API

params.name: StackName
params.description: The name that is associated with the stack. The name must be unique in the Region in which you are creating the stack.

params.name: TemplateURL
params.description: Location of file containing the template body.

params.name: DisableRollback
params.description: Set to true to disable rollback of the stack if stack creation failed.

params.name: TimeoutInMinutes
params.description: The amount of time that can pass before the stack status becomes CREATE_FAILED.

items.docs: Creates a stack as specified in the template. After the call completes successfully, the stack creation starts. You can check the status of the stack through the DescribeStacks action.

params.name: StackName
params.description: The name or the unique stack ID that is associated with the stack.

params.name: NextToken
params.description: A string that identifies the next page of stacks to retrieve.

items.docs: Returns the description for the specified stack; if no stack name was specified, then it returns the description for all the stacks created.

params.name: StackName
params.description: The name or unique stack ID of the stack to update.

params.name: TemplateURL
params.description: Location of file containing the template body.

params.name: UsePreviousTemplate
params.description: Reuse the existing template that is associated with the stack.

items.docs: Updates a stack as specified in the template. After the call completes successfully, the stack update starts.

params.name: StackName
params.description: The name or the unique stack ID that is associated with the stack.

params.name: RetainResources
params.description: For stacks in the DELETE_FAILED state, a list of resource logical IDs that are associated with the resources you want to retain.

items.docs: Deletes a specified stack. Once the call completes successfully, stack deletion starts. Deleted stacks do not show up in the DescribeStacks action if the deletion has been completed successfully.

params.name: NextToken
params.description: A string that identifies the next page of stacks to retrieve.

params.name: StackStatusFilter
params.description: Stack status to use as a filter.

items.docs: Returns the summary information for stacks whose status matches the specified StackStatusFilter.
